title: Trace Ingest Debug Proxy with Replay, Sampling Insights, and SLO Telemetry
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: When production tracing shows SLO regressions or unexplained latency spikes, engineers need a low-friction, tenant-safe way to reproduce ingest-time behavior and validate sampling/normalization rules across backends. Current debugging requires ad-hoc heavy instrumentation or full trace replays through Kafka and is slow, fragile, and risky for PII.

Proposal: Build a Trace Ingest Debug Proxy: an intermediary OTLP-compatible proxy that sits in front of the ingest pipeline and provides: 1) on-demand synthetic-span replay (time-travel replay) for a tenant or trace sample; 2) per-tenant sampling-insight headers and visualizable sampling decision traces; 3) safe replay channels to staging/isolated backends with automatic PII redaction and TTL; 4) SLO telemetry hooks to annotate dashboards when replays occur. The proxy will be lightweight, opt-in per-tenant, and instrumented for auditability and rate-control.

Goals:
- Reduce mean-time-to-detect root cause for trace-related SLO regressions by 30% for incidents where traces are actionable.
- Provide reproducible replay path for sampled traces and synthetic spans without impacting live ingest.
- Surface sampling decisions and delta between sampled vs full spans so engineers can reason about missed telemetry.
- Ensure tenant isolation, privacy (PII redaction), and non-destructive replay semantics.

Non-goals: Full historical reprocessing across long-term storage, replacing long-lived Kafka replays, or altering production sampling policy by default.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy accepts OTLP/gRPC and OTLP/HTTP ingest and can forward to existing pipeline endpoints without schema changes
UI can trigger a replay job for a single trace ID or a synthetic-span template scoped to a tenant
Replay jobs are routed to isolated staging backends when tenant has replay flag enabled; production routing is opt-in and rate-limited
All replay payloads pass through automatic PII redaction rules configurable per-tenant and logged to audit stream
Sampling decision header is appended to spans (sampling.debug=true + sampler_reason) and visible in trace viewer and trace export
SLO telemetry events (replay.start, replay.end, replay.failed) emitted to metrics pipeline and appear on latency/error dashboards within 2 minutes
End-to-end integration tests validate replay fidelity against a golden trace (structure and attributes within allowed differences)
implementation_notes: Proxy implemented in Go with existing otel proto support; reuse connection pooling from edge-ingress service
Replay queue is ephemeral (Redis-backed) with TTL default 24h; each replay job stores only sanitized envelope
Add middleware hook to enrich sampling.debug header and sampler_reason for each processed span
Tenant-level config stored in Tenant Config Service: replay_allowed, replay_rate_per_minute, pii_redaction_profile
Provide two replay modes: 'replay-live' (for production backends, strictly rate-limited + audit) and 'replay-staging' (default, safe)
Expose admin API (internal) to cancel replays and retrieve replay logs for investigations
Design for backpressure: if downstream is overloaded, proxy returns polite HTTP 429 and emits replay.failed metric
test_plan: Unit tests for PII redaction rules using representative attribute sets (emails, phone, user_id, tokens)
Integration test: ingest synthetic span set, trigger replay-staging, validate arrival at staging collector and presence of sampling.debug header
Load test: simulate 100 concurrent replays across tenants to validate rate-limit enforcement and queue TTL behavior
Chaos test: simulate downstream staging collector outage and assert graceful failure and metrics emission
Security test: verify tenant cannot replay another tenant's traces; test role-based access for replay API
rollout_plan: Week 1: Feature-flagged deployment to internal observability namespace; enable replay-staging for SRE only
Week 2: Expand to a small set of trusted customers (beta) with replay_allowed opt-in; monitor metrics and audit logs
Week 3: Open self-serve in Console for tenants to enable replay-staging; disable replay-live by default
Week 4: After successful beta, provide documentation and release notes; enable replay-live for enterprise tenants with signed SLA
Rollback: Disable tenant flag and purge replay queue; ensure audit log for rollback action
